entities.summary: Carly Maria McKillip is a Canadian former actress and singer. She is known for her title role in the television series Alice, I Think. She also provided the voice of Sakura Avalon, the title character of the Nelvana-dubbed anime television series Cardcaptors. She was occasionally miscredited as Carly McKillup.
